title: Milestone review: match the picture
source: Book milestones 5–10 (new sentences built from their words)
notes: Like the book's milestone pages: read (or hear) a sentence and pick the emoji that matches it.
These are new sentences that reuse the milestone vocabulary, so you can't answer from memory of the book.
